regulatory_frameworks.notes: Release 0.4.0b1 preserves the stable 0.3.0 PCG/FEC regulatory qualification unchanged while adding generic LOT-20 read-only financial-analysis mechanics over sealed accounting/reporting evidence. Indicator/ratio definitions, working-capital analysis, trends and diagnostics do not broaden statutory-template, legal-filing, DGFiP-filing or authority-submission claims, and no account-prefix semantic inference is introduced.

SYSCOHADA remains qualified through LOT-17 deterministic XOF golden/replay scenarios. Release 0.4.0b1 adds only generic LOT-20 read-only financial-analysis mechanics and does not change the existing SYSCOHADA regulatory qualification boundary, claim an equivalent FEC ingestion path, infer semantics from SYSCOHADA account prefixes or provide statutory filing certification.
